title: Grant Recipient Continuity — integrated native records v2
description: Proposed documentation contract. Seven canonical record kinds. Shape validation does not qualify a target, verify hashes, authorize signing, or replace machine/semantic-guards.json. No executable record instances are supplied.

ReadAnchor.description: A finalized anchor. The three context IDs must match the corresponding complete context bindings. Initial profile admits new action snapshots only at a stable reviewed block; upgrade-block receipt evidence can remain unresolved.

GateRecord.description: A domain assessment at one stage and subject, not a blanket pass of all prerequisites or future outputs. Profile capability acceptance is separate from current action input and finalized output.

CallTree.description: Closed descriptive grammar; no Utility, generic forwarding, hash-only approval, requestChanges, release, remove_proxies or kill_pure. Semantic guards compare values, role bindings, exact metadata-encoded bytes and ABI data; structural validity alone cannot authorize.

intentRevision.description: Semantic plan revision, not a mutable observation counter. See SG-29. First sealed revision is 1; changed semantic content requires a higher revision or new intentId.

ChainProfile.description: Accepted binds exact runtime identity. Each operation independently requires capability and fresh input gates. LOCAL uses source/build evidence; the pinned portaldot-v3 runtime can use explicit runtime-artifact verification with no source-provenance claim. Both support exact metadata versions 14, 15 or 16. Other targets retain metadata version 14.

status.description: Local immutable revision state; approved means local review, never a count of native approvals.

semanticIntentDigest.description: SHA256 of RFC8785 JCS of the exact semantic projection defined in semantic-guards.json.semantic_intent_identity. Separate from the full immutable record digest. Null only for an unsealed draft.

SignedAttempt.description: Exists only after exact signed bytes are returned and verified. Durable locally before explicit send. Portable export is a newly identified redacted record; no signed-byte recovery export in first profile. Unknown wallet outcome belongs to LocalOperationProgress until a signed hash is known.

ReceiptBundle.description: Dispatch success and verified business effect are independent. Direct F/R has no native proposal. Cancellation refers to targetProposalAfter. First-approval receipt cannot establish inner execution. Historical business context uses ordered events, not only final getter state.

AccountingLedger.description: Split creator-funded D from P-funded incremental f. A recorded proxy deposit is not all P-held. Holds, named reserves and other liabilities must be disjoint source-qualified buckets; total_balance_on_hold is already aggregate reserved. Semantic arithmetic and complete provenance are mandatory.

Params_GRC_GRANT_RECLAIM.$comment: Historical/source grammar only. Not reachable through an enabled Intent operation branch in grc-v2-local-1; never author, sign or broadcast from this definition.

Params_GRC_VESTING_VEST.$comment: Historical/source grammar only. Not reachable through an enabled Intent operation branch in grc-v2-local-1; never author, sign or broadcast from this definition.

Params_GRC_MULTISIG_CANCEL.description: Target preimage is inert provenance only. FrozenEnvelope.innerRuntimeCallBytes is the actual direct cancel_as_multi call, not this target preimage. Reobserve exact target instance/depositor/clock before reconstruction.

Tree_ReviveReclaim.$comment: Historical/source grammar only. Not reachable through an enabled Intent operation branch in grc-v2-local-1; never author, sign or broadcast from this definition.

Tree_ProxyVest.$comment: Historical/source grammar only. Not reachable through an enabled Intent operation branch in grc-v2-local-1; never author, sign or broadcast from this definition.

originalSignPayloadJcsUtf8.description: RFC8785 JCS text of the exact JSON value supplied to signPayload, preserving JSON numeric value types inside this string. Strict duplicate-key/Unicode/prototype validation applies to the embedded JSON too. Parse and JCS reserialize must reproduce this string exactly; hash its UTF-8 bytes. Do not convert wallet JSON numbers to decimal strings or regenerate from extracted fields.

ReviewedSigningContext.description: originalSignPayloadJcsUtf8 is the exact RFC8785 serialization of the reviewed wallet-request JSON object, preserving its native numeric values inside the string; signPayloadSha256 hashes its UTF-8 bytes. Extracted schema numeric fields remain decimal strings. Do not stringify wallet numeric fields before computing the request digest.

reviewedSigningContext.description: Full exact wallet request and additional-signed context committed atomically before invoking the wallet. Null only before request preparation in Prepared. Hashes alone are insufficient.

LocalOperationProgress.description: Local-only append-only progress, including a hashless pre-signature attempt. A durably committed WalletRequested record contains the complete reviewedSigningContext before any wallet invocation; request and context never mutate. WalletRequested after a crash means invocation/outcome may be unknown, not proof that a prompt appeared. No SignedAttempt or signed hash exists until exact signed bytes have returned and passed guards.

$comment: JSON Schema structural limits are numeric by specification. Instance financial values, counts, indices and version counters are canonical decimal strings. API and signing types remain blocked until exact target binding. Local unpublished contract revision grc-v2-local-1 is mandatory on instances; structural schemaVersion remains 2. No deployed compatibility or runtime validation is asserted.
